item.title: Nagato Citrus: Mikan Picking on the Coast — Guide
item.description: The warm, sunlit coast around Nagato in northern Yamaguchi is ideal citrus country, and the area is known for its mikan — the small, sweet, easy-peel mandarin oranges that are a staple of Japanese autumn and winter. In season, orchards on the hillsides open for fruit picking, letting visitors wander among the trees, pick sun-ripened mikan straight from the branch, and eat their fill of the sweet, juicy fruit. Set against the backdrop of the scenic Nagato coast and the islands offshore, it is a relaxed, family-friendly outing and a refreshing, healthy taste of the region — a gentle counterpoint to Nagato’s dramatic shrine and wilder coastline.
